content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring), which cited that precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10), with I48.91 also submitted. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management, supporting the medical necessity of the service billed. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of $738.30 on this episode."}
